text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Ngh, not again… What is it now?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh, is that you, Air Groove? What has you sighing?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Oh, Flower. To tell you the truth…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: The flowers here are growing better than I'd planned.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh wow! But, isn't that a good thing?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Well, it's important to know why this is happening. I selected specific fertilizers for each species' growth rate. But now, this makes it difficult to determine what amounts I should use.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh, I understand now. Then I suppose you'll have to relay that information to the flower lovers.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: The flower lovers? I've already spoken with the groundskeeping committee.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: No, not them. Who I'm talking about may already be here…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: (Is that Taishin? Why is she turning the flowerpots?)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Too much sunlight. This one'll end up browning.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: The plots aren't carved out right. I heard you need to give each plant enough space.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: I'll take one off you.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh! Good morning, Air Groove!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Morning, Flower. Thanks to you, I have a clearer picture of things.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Sigh… If they're so interested in visiting the flowers, they might as well be part of the committee. I'll write a recommendation letter tomorrow…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah! Sorry, but… would it be possible to let them be?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Flowers can… wilt if you give them too much attention.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You're right. I'll make mention of it as a point of concern and leave it at that.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: But I have to say, you know quite a lot about growing flowers yourself.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh, I just do what I can, hehe… But thank you very much.
